theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (p c : ℝ), 0 < p → 0 ≤ c → (∀ w : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 w → HasCompactSupport w → (∫ z, |w z| ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ c * ∫ z, ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖) → ∀ (u : Euclid P → ℝ) (M : ℝ), Integrable u → HasCompactSupport u → (∀ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ z, u z * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)| ≤ M) → ∀ η : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (η k)) → (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (η k)) → (∀ k z, 0 ≤ η k z) → (∀ k z, η k (-z) = η k z) → (∀ k, ∫ z, η k z = 1) → (∀ᵐ x, Tendsto (fun k => convolution (η k) u (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x) atTop (𝓝 (u x))) → (∫ z, |u z| ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤ c * M
